sections.text:
BioIntel Demo
Kinase reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 8. The compound vemurafenib was discussed with target BRAF in the context of melanoma. The example mutation is V600E. A demonstration IC50 measurement of 609 nM is shown for Homo sapiens. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0008 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0008.
